description: v1.17 E1: LLM spend policy and per-role model pins (iap.llm.prices.load_llm_config). Caps are enforced by iap.llm.budget.Budget against the shared spend ledger (iap.llm.spend) before every model call. Pins are dated snapshots: `model` is an explicit id listed in configs/reference/llm_prices.json, `pinned` the date the pin was decided; a session records the pin and the price table's `checked` date it ran under. Change a pin in its own PR.
